key.name: default-mail-account
key.description: The id of the account new mail is sent from. Empty means the first account that can send mail.

key.name: send-format
key.description: Whether new mail is sent as formatted (HTML) or plain text.

key.name: notification-policy
key.description: Which messages notify: all of them, only those that mention you or are direct, or none.

key.name: welcome-shown
key.description: Whether the first-run welcome has been shown. The first suite app opened says it once for the whole suite.
